name: Otokoyu de Deatta Shoujo Akane
original_name: 男湯で出会った少女あかね
source:
The bare-naked lolita stood in front of the fan in an all-male hot spa.
She had no sense of shame. She liked the eyes of men on her hairless body.
Let's play with this provocateur.
